listed_sector_signals.signal: One of the five analyzed SEP-certified facilities is described as a 'chemical' facility; its energy consumption and relevant-variable data were used in the regression analysis, though production mode (continuous vs. batch) is not stated
listed_sector_signals.quote: The five facilities span a wide range of industrial subsectors including chemical, power generation equipment manufacturing, automotive assembly, and food processing.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Iron and steel facility cited only as a hypothetical example of cross-facility EPI% comparison, not a facility actually analyzed

one_line: The paper compares absolute, intensity, and normalization (regression) bases for calculating facility-wide industrial energy savings under ISO 50001 / DOE Superior Energy Performance, applying them to data from five SEP-certified facilities (chemical, power-generation equipment manufacturing, automotive assembly, food processing) without characterizing their production mode as continuous.
